title: 戏为六绝句 二
author: 杜甫
prompt: Edit this exact Chinese ink-watercolor illustration, preserve the pavilion writing table, river, mountains, brush pot, autumn branches and broad blank lower paper. Remove every written mark, pseudo-Chinese character, ink scribble and line of writing from the open scroll and hanging paper on the table. Make the scroll and papers plain blank ivory paper, with their folds and subtle paper texture intact. Absolutely no lettering. Keep everything else unchanged.
visualReview: 已逐图查看修改版：江河远去与案上文房表现诗文长存的比兴，避免凭空画四杰同场；纸卷伪字已全部移除，留白充足。
